articles.title: Interview Inactivity Timeout
articles.content: HackerRank interviews have an inactivity timeout to prevent idle sessions. The default timeout is 20 minutes for both interviewers and candidates. If a user is inactive (no mouse/keyboard activity) for this duration, they may be returned to the lobby. To extend timeout: Ensure active participation by moving mouse or interacting. There is no user-configurable setting to extend this timeout; contact support for special accommodations.

articles.title: Mock Interviews
articles.content: Mock interviews are practice sessions available in HackerRank Community. They simulate real interview conditions. Technical issues should be reported to support. Refunds for mock interviews are handled on a case-by-case basis and require human review.
